sourcePackage: 作物适配浇水器_美术资源包_V2
scope: New assets only. Existing Markdown, HTML, static images and game code unchanged.

formats.atlas: Straight-alpha PNG plus per-frame JSON for game integration

coordinates: All paths in clips.files are relative to this new package. clips.source paths are relative to the parent V2 art package.
stateAuthority: All playback is cosmetic. World actions, moisture, volume, skill unlock and save state remain authoritative in game logic.
